description: AR AEB acute warning fires but AEB state is not active, so no icon is drawn. gate=ADAS fusion(0x4C1 6.2-6.3)=1, ONLINE_0x32D(0x32D 5.6)=1, Acute_Warning_S(0x32D 5.3)=1 but AEB_State_S(0x32D 5.4)=0. The acute branch requires both acuteWaring_==0x1 AND aebStates_==0x1, so mAEBImage is not drawn (matches baseline TC-AEB-ACUTE only in the negative/absent-state direction).
